profile.summary: America SCORES Bay Area is a nonprofit, out-of-school-time youth program. It combines soccer, poetry and service-learning to support students' healthy lifestyles, engagement in school and confidence. It partners with public elementary and middle schools and after-school providers in the San Francisco Bay Area.
